verdict.rationale: Cake's own docs claim board sign-offs and e-signing via automated flows for stock option grants, and digital signing within its SAFE/convertible raise workflow, so routing board approval for e-signature is documented, at least for option grants. Nothing in the evidence shows board consents or stockholder approvals being drafted as documents, or archived and linked to the transactions they authorize. Missing for 10: board consent/resolution drafting templates, stockholder approval workflows, archiving of signed consents against the authorized transactions, coverage beyond option grants, independent or hands-on corroboration.
